name: Jester's Crypt
description: A dark, shadow-shrouded tunnel in Rix Maadi where Rakdos takes displeasing cultists and where blood witches are created.

description_citations.text: "Rix Maadi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tomik Vrona delivers Hekara's corpse to the Jester's Crypt where she is resurrected as a blood witch.
timeline.quote: where she was resurrected into a blood witch

citation.text: "Rix Maadi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Exava and six blood witches dress Hekara's body in rags and bells and send it with the thrull into the Jester's Crypt, where the thrull is killed.
timeline.quote: Have your thrull take Hekara into the Jester's Crypt.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Hekara emerges from the Jester's Crypt alive, resurrected as a blood witch.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
